Messages.Author: Oshi
Messages.Body:
"Forward Momentum
Unique.
Put this card in play. After a vampire who follows the Path of Cathari you control bleeds, if the bleed is successful (for 1 or more), add 1 counter to this card; otherwise, burn 1 counter from this card. After a vampire who follows the Path of Cathari you control performs an action, you can burn 2 counters from this card to unlock them."

At which point does "After a vampire who follows the Path of Cathari you control bleeds" trigger?

Is it at the point a bleed action is announced? Or after the bleed action is successful? Or somewhere in between?

For clarities sake which if the following would cause forward momentum to lose a counter:  bleed reduced to 0 bleed is blocked action ends to change of target bleed action card is cancelled by DI bleed action is cancelled by tangle atropos' hand

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Oshi wrote:
> "Forward Momentum
> Unique.
> Put this card in play. After a vampire who follows the Path of Cathari you control bleeds, if the bleed is successful (for 1 or more), add 1 counter to this card; otherwise, burn 1 counter from this card. After a vampire who follows the Path of Cathari you control performs an action, you can burn 2 counters from this card to unlock them."
>
> At which point does "After a vampire who follows the Path of Cathari you control bleeds" trigger?
>
After resolution of the action.

> Oshi wrote:
> For clarities sake which if the following would cause forward momentum to lose a counter:  bleed reduced to 0 bleed is blocked action ends to change of target bleed action card is cancelled by DI bleed action is cancelled by tangle atropos' hand
>
1. burn (the bleed was not succesful)
2. burn (the bleed action was not succesful)
3. burn (idem)
4. Don’t burn (the action didn't reach resolution)
5. Don't burn (idem)
